back: The repetition of a block of statements; each execution of the block is a pass.
FOR Count ← 1 TO 10 STEP 2 ... NEXT Count. Python: for count in range(1, 11, 2): (the stop value is excluded).
WHILE condition DO ... ENDWHILE. Pre-condition loop: may run zero times; continues while the condition is true.
REPEAT ... UNTIL condition. Post-condition loop: runs at least once; stops when the condition is true. Python: while True with break.
Set to 0 before the loop, update inside it, use after it. Guard against a count of zero before dividing.
A special value that ends the input (such as -1) and is not processed as data.
Repeat the input until the value is acceptable; a post-condition loop asks at least once.
The inner loop runs completely for each pass of the outer loop: 4 × 3 × 2 = 24 passes of the innermost body.
A loop whose condition can never change to stop it, often because the variable in the condition is not updated in the body.
